findings.desc: CHK-004:happy:7 evidence note claims no gemini script in package.json but root package.json line 32 still has test:usage-ledger-codex-gemini pointing to packages/main/dist/tasks/usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke.js which does not exist (renamed to usage-ledger-codex-antigravity-smoke.js). The bound command grep -n provider-antigravity||codex-antigravity||provider-gemini||codex-gemini package.json would reveal the stale entry. The file usage-ledger-codex-gemini-smoke.js cannot be found at runtime: node throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND. The intent requires no gemini script in package.json; evidence claim is factually incorrect.
